comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
R11 Handicrafts recipe "Making Boots with Spurs" -- only appears from Aide Production, and requires an Aide with +1 Handicrafts, base rank 11 Handicrafts (player), and 19th Century Adept of Ages title equipped. Ingredients:

Suede x10
Leather Cords x15
Steel x5

Stats: +1 Livestock Trading, 11k fame to equip, color-customizable (Blue, Black, Purple)

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/RecipeShow?id=2237
